description: Options expiration calendar — Offline US options and derivatives expiration calendar on the NYSE holiday calendar: standard monthly (third Friday), weekly, end-of-quarter, quarterly triple witching and VIX (Wednesday rule) expirations, each moved to the preceding business day around holidays such as Good Friday and Juneteenth, with next dates and days until. Params: from (YYYY-MM-DD, default today), months (1-24, default 3), type (all or monthly,weekly,quarterly,witching,vix), date= to check one day, extra_holidays= for special closures. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_options_expirations
